summary: Ported the Hub BFF session transaction to the 2.x three-state read contract on the installed hub-sdk 1.3.1, without bumping the SDK. withSession now resolves ONE outcome under the row lock before the operation runs: absent for a missing row, expired plus an in-transaction delete for a row past either timestamp, found for a live row whose seal opens, and absent with the row LEFT IN PLACE for an unopenable seal. get() survives for the 1.3.1 BFF as a pure projection of read(). The durable store declares kind 'persistent' and a new EphemeralHubSessionStore subclass supplies kind 'ephemeral' for the memory fallback, with both createHubSessionStore envelope tags ('durable' | 'memory') unchanged. Also adopted slice 02's one-line header comment rename FXL_HUB_SECRET_KEY to FXL_HUB_CLIENT_SECRET, and recorded the contract in CLAUDE.md.

commits.subject: test(auth): pin the three-state session read contract
feat(auth): answer the session transaction with a three-state read
docs(claude): record the three-state session read contract

oracles_written.title: reports absent and leaves the row when the seal will not open, so a wrong key costs one re-login rather than data
reports expired and deletes the row inside the same transaction when only the absolute expiry has passed
reports expired and deletes the row inside the same transaction when only the sliding expiry has passed
reports absent and deletes nothing when there is no row at all
reports found with the stored refresh token when neither expiry has passed
never lets get() and read() disagree about the same locked row
declares kind persistent on the durable store and ephemeral on the in-process fallback, without moving the factory envelope tags

concerns: The plan's prescribed Omit<HubSessionStore, 'withSession'> fallback was NOT needed: tsc accepted the narrowed withSession redeclaration on DurableHubSessionStore as written. No cast was added.
RED was recorded before the implementation: all seven new tests failed, six with 'handle.read is not a function' and the seventh with 'expected undefined to be persistent'.

The integration suite (apps/api/test/rls/hub-bff-session-store.test.ts, hub-bff-login-supersede.test.ts) was NOT run per instruction; it calls tx.get(), which survives this slice unchanged, so it is expected green but is unverified here.
